choices.reason: No rule separates the candidates: both report the same full-sample, unadjusted paired originality contrast, with no primary/main designation distinguishing them and no differences in arms, tasks or sessions. Neither confirms participant-level aggregation or SDs, and neither source record supplies data_stats, so the later report's additional z statistic and r interval do not satisfy rule 3.
